### Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control what it does. We must face that reality now and act before we build something we cannot govern.

2. We believe the stakes are clear: build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and governments will be unable to control what it does. This is not a problem we can solve after the fact.

3. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will be beyond government control. We need to reckon with that before development gets ahead of our ability to respond.

### Newsletter opening

We are approaching a turning point in the development of artificial intelligence. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control what it does. That is the reality we must confront—not a distant concern to set aside, and not a challenge that can be fixed after the technology arrives. The decisions made today will shape whether we build systems beyond our ability to govern. We believe public debate must start from this plain fact. Our newsletter will explore what is at stake, why government control will fail, and what responsibilities follow when powerful technology cannot be reliably directed by those charged with protecting the public.
